headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a convincing 10-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jake Mangum leading the offense. Mangum's impressive performance included 4 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. In other action, the New York Mets took down the Kansas City Royals 7-3, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 7.0 innings pitched. The New York Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-4 victory behind Ben Rice's 2 home runs and 5 RBIs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Victor Bericoto of the San Francisco Giants has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The Minnesota Twins have also placed Mick Abel on the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation, while Zack Gelof of the Athletics is out with a right knee laceration. Mark Vientos of the New York Mets is on the 10-day injured list with a right hand fracture, and Matt McLain of the Cincinnati Reds has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 8, 2026, with a left calf strain.

The Minnesota Twins have made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Ryan Sprock and future considerations. The New York Mets have also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers for cash.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Past Pirates 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a convincing 10-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jake Mangum leading the offense. Mangum's impressive performance included 4 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 7.0 innings pitched. Tyrone Taylor led the Royals' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Juan Soto's 21st home run of the season was a key play for the Mets.

top_news.title: **Yankees Blast Past Rays 12-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-4 victory. Ben Rice led the Yankees' offense with a remarkable performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 5 runs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dropped a 2-3 decision to the Baltimore Orioles in a closely contested matchup. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Orioles' strong pitching.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Victor Bericoto on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants right fielder Victor Bericoto has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain.

top_news.title: **Twins Acquire Tommy Nance in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins have acquired right-handed pitcher Tommy Nance in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays. In exchange, the Blue Jays received catcher Ryan Sprock and future considerations.
